title: The World Of The Unseen The 5 Truths Of Revelation

questions.question: What did the traveller want to learn when he turned his attention to the hidden world?
questions.answer: He wanted to know what that unseen world would tell him.

questions.question: From the beautiful and skillful things in the visible world, what did he understand about their Maker?
questions.answer: He understood that the Maker wants to be known, loved, and recognized through His perfect works and blessings.

questions.question: How does the passage say this showing is first done?
questions.answer: It is first done through actions, states, and the way creation itself points to Him.

questions.question: What did the traveller conclude must also happen besides showing through actions?
questions.answer: He concluded that Allah would also speak and make Himself known through speech.

questions.question: With what two inner abilities did the traveller enter the unseen world?
questions.answer: He entered it with his heart and his intellect.

questions.question: What powerful reality did he see spreading through the unseen world?
questions.answer: He saw the truth of revelation spreading strongly through all parts of it.

questions.question: According to the passage, how strong is the witness of revelation compared with the witness of the universe?
questions.answer: It is stronger than the witness given by the universe and created things.

questions.question: Why is revelation such a strong proof?
questions.answer: Because it comes from the Knower of the unseen and directly testifies to His existence and oneness.

questions.question: Does the passage present Allah as leaving His existence to be known only through creation?
questions.answer: No. It says He also makes Himself known by His own speech.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s speech?
questions.answer: It teaches that His speech fits His being, is without end, and makes both Him and His attributes known.

questions.question: What made the truth of revelation clear and obvious to the traveller?
questions.answer: The agreement of one hundred thousand prophets, their matching messages, and the miracles and proofs found in the holy books made it clear.

questions.question: What role did the sacred books and heavenly pages have in the passage?
questions.answer: They were guides for most people and clear fruits that came from revelation.

questions.question: How many holy truths did the traveller understand revelation was announcing at that point?
questions.answer: He understood that it announced five sacred truths.

questions.question: Before those five truths were listed, what had the traveller already become sure about revelation itself?
questions.answer: He had become sure that revelation is real, true, and truly exists.

questions.question: When the traveller reflected on the unseen world, what question was in his mind?
questions.answer: He was wondering what message that hidden world had to give.

questions.question: What in the visible world helped him realize that there is One behind the unseen?
questions.answer: The many beautiful, carefully made, and generous gifts in the visible world helped him realize that.

questions.question: What three things did the traveller understand that the Maker wants people to know?
questions.answer: He wants people to know Him, love Him, and recognize His hidden perfection.

questions.question: Why did the traveller think speech must exist along with deeds?
questions.answer: Because One who introduces Himself through what He does would also make Himself known through words.

questions.question: What truth was described as being present at every moment in every part of the unseen world?
questions.answer: The truth of revelation was described that way.

questions.question: What comes together with revelation and inspiration in the passage?
questions.answer: A strong witness to Allah’s existence and His oneness comes with them.

questions.question: From whom do the truths of revelation and inspiration come?
questions.answer: They come from the One who knows the unseen.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah’s knowledge and power in relation to His speech?
questions.answer: It says the One who is present everywhere by His knowledge and power has endless speech.

questions.question: Besides making Allah known, what else does His speech show?
questions.answer: It also shows His attributes.

questions.question: Whose agreement made the reality of revelation very clear?
questions.answer: The agreement of one hundred thousand prophets made it very clear.

questions.question: What in the holy books and heavenly pages supported the truth of revelation?
questions.answer: Their signs, proofs, and miracles supported it.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the place of these books among people?
questions.answer: It says they guide most of humanity and are accepted by them.

questions.question: What did the traveller understand after thinking about the prophets and the holy books?
questions.answer: He understood that revelation is clearly real and that it declares five sacred truths.

questions.question: What did the traveller do as he explored the World of the Unseen?
questions.answer: He examined it carefully and searched it with his intellect and heart.

questions.question: What idea did he reach by looking at the works of creation in the visible world?
questions.answer: He reached the idea that their Creator wants to be known and loved.

questions.question: How do blessings and works of art point to that idea?
questions.answer: They show care, beauty, and skill, which point to a Maker who introduces His gifts and perfection.

questions.question: What does “by act rather than speech” mean in this part?
questions.answer: It means showing signs through creation and blessings before speaking with words.

questions.question: What did the traveller infer from this about speech?
questions.answer: He inferred that the Maker would certainly also speak and not only show signs through actions.

questions.question: Why did he think the unseen world would help him know Allah better?
questions.answer: Because he believed Allah would be known there through His manifestations and speech.

questions.question: What did he witness spreading strongly through the unseen world?
questions.answer: He witnessed the powerful reality of revelation spreading through it.

questions.question: Which gives a stronger testimony in the passage: created things or revelation from Allah?
questions.answer: Revelation from Allah gives the stronger testimony.

questions.question: What mistake does the passage reject about knowing Allah?
questions.answer: It rejects the idea that Allah leaves people to know Him only from creation.

questions.question: What special quality of Allah’s speech is mentioned more than once in meaning?
questions.answer: Its endless nature is mentioned.

questions.question: How was the truth of revelation confirmed by the prophets?
questions.answer: It was confirmed by the very large number of prophets and their united message about revelation.

questions.question: How were the sacred books connected to revelation?
questions.answer: They were results of revelation and contained miracles and proofs supporting it.

questions.question: What does the passage say those books were for humanity?
questions.answer: They were examples and guides for most people.

questions.question: After all of this, what number of sacred truths did the traveller understand revelation was proclaiming?
questions.answer: He understood that it was proclaiming five sacred truths.

questions.question: What world did the traveller focus on in this passage?
questions.answer: He focused on the World of the Unseen.

questions.question: What did he seem to do, in a figurative way, to begin learning from that world?
questions.answer: He was described as knocking on its door with curiosity.

questions.question: What did the many beautiful things in the physical world make clear to him?
questions.answer: They made clear that there is One behind them who wants to be recognized.

questions.question: What do the many blessings show about the One who gives them?
questions.answer: They show that He wants to be loved.

questions.question: What do the many amazing works show about His qualities?
questions.answer: They show His hidden perfection and great skill.

questions.question: If the Maker shows Himself through deeds, what else did the traveller say must be true?
questions.answer: He must also make Himself known through speech.

questions.question: What did the traveller use together in order to enter this study of the unseen?
questions.answer: He used both his heart and his intellect.

questions.question: What was ruling or dominating throughout the unseen world?
questions.answer: The truth of revelation was prevailing throughout it.

questions.question: Why is testimony from revelation especially weighty in this passage?
questions.answer: Because it comes directly from Allah, the Knower of the unseen, and speaks of His existence and oneness.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s speech in relation to time?
questions.answer: It teaches that His speech is not limited or temporary, but ongoing and endless.

questions.question: What two things about Allah are made known by His speech and its meaning?
questions.answer: His very being and His attributes are made known.

questions.question: Which group strongly supported the truth of revelation by agreeing with one another?
questions.answer: One hundred thousand prophets strongly supported it.

questions.question: What supports inside the sacred books helped prove revelation?
questions.answer: Their miracles and clear evidences helped prove it.

questions.question: What was the next big point the traveller understood about revelation?
questions.answer: He understood that revelation announces five holy truths.

questions.question: In this passage, what kind of journey was the traveller making?
questions.answer: He was making a journey of thought and faith into the unseen world.

questions.question: What did he learn from the carefully made things in the seen world?
questions.answer: He learned that their Creator is introducing Himself through them.

questions.question: What did he learn from the many delightful gifts given in the world?
questions.answer: He learned that the Giver wants to be loved.

questions.question: What did he learn from the many wonderful and skillful creations?
questions.answer: He learned that they show hidden perfect qualities of their Maker.

questions.question: Why did he believe words must also come from Allah?
questions.answer: Because One who makes Himself known by deeds would also do so by speech.

questions.question: After this thought, where did the traveller turn to know Allah better?
questions.answer: He turned to the World of the Unseen.

questions.question: What did he notice first there?
questions.answer: He noticed the strong and constant reality of revelation in that world.

questions.question: Revelation and inspiration bring testimony about which two beliefs?
questions.answer: They testify to Allah’s existence and His oneness.

questions.question: What comparison is made between revelation’s testimony and the testimony of creatures?
questions.answer: Revelation’s testimony is said to be much stronger.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah does instead of only letting creation speak about Him?
questions.answer: It says He speaks Himself with an eternal speech.

questions.question: What does Allah’s discourse make known besides its message?
questions.answer: It also makes His attributes known.

questions.question: Which people gave a united witness that revelation is real?
questions.answer: The prophets, in the very large number mentioned, gave that united witness.

questions.question: How did the holy books serve as proof in addition to the prophets?
questions.answer: They contained signs and miracles and showed the results of revelation clearly.

questions.question: What final understanding did the traveller reach at the end of this marked passage?
questions.answer: He reached the understanding that revelation declares five sacred truths.

questions.question: What was the traveller trying to hear from the unseen world?
questions.answer: He was trying to hear its message and what it reveals.

questions.question: What signs in the visible world led him toward this search?
questions.answer: The beauty, order, blessings, and skill in creation led him toward it.

questions.question: According to his thinking, what do these signs tell us about the Creator’s purpose?
questions.answer: They tell us that He wants to be known, loved, and recognized for His perfection.

questions.question: What conclusion did the traveller draw from that “language”?
questions.answer: He concluded that the Creator would also speak with actual speech.

questions.question: How did the traveller enter the unseen world in this description?
questions.answer: He entered with his heart and saw with his intellect.

questions.question: What truth did he find to be powerfully present everywhere in that world?
questions.answer: He found the truth of revelation to be powerfully present everywhere there.

questions.question: Why is the witness of revelation stronger than the witness of created things?
questions.answer: Because it comes directly from Allah and openly declares His existence and unity.

questions.question: What false idea about Allah’s guidance does the passage reject?
questions.answer: It rejects the idea that Allah would only let creatures point to Him without speaking Himself.

questions.question: What do we learn about Allah’s speech from this passage?
questions.answer: We learn that it fits His being, has no end, and shows both Him and His attributes.

questions.question: What made the existence of revelation almost impossible to deny for the traveller?
questions.answer: The united witness of many prophets and the proofs and miracles in the sacred books made it nearly self-evident.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the effect of the sacred books on humanity?
questions.answer: It says they have guided most people and have been accepted by them.

questions.question: How do the prophets’ messages help support one another?
questions.answer: Their messages agree with each other about divine revelation.

questions.question: What important announcement of revelation was the traveller ready to learn next?
questions.answer: He was ready to learn the five sacred truths proclaimed by revelation.
